This is a build-time helper script sourced from the PKGBUILD for the `plasticity-4arch` AUR package. It includes a verification pass confirming each patched file reports `$ORIGIN` as its rpath, and an opt-in ld.so.conf.d fragment writer (off by default via `--with-ld-fragment`). The `return 0 2>/dev/null || true` tail guard and `BASH_SOURCE` check are standard dual-mode sourcing/execution patterns.

No network requests, downloads, obfuscation, `eval`, `base64` decoding, or execution of attacker-controlled code are present. No data exfiltration or system-level modifications occur outside `$pkgdir`. All behaviors are consistent with the stated packaging fix and standard AUR practices.
</details>
